The wordmark used as a graphic on the product itself
avoid: A home page with no product prices or reviews
A 10% pop-up as the strongest ask
Text over photos at 1.94:1; 27 tap targets under 24px

business.what: Liposomal supplements (immunity, longevity), one-time and subscription prices ($55-$79), direct to consumer.

library_candidates: Large radius on cards and images (30-55px) for a soft, modern feel
Price, subscription price and review count next to add to cart
Doctor quote and third-party testing as proof near the offer
avoid: Unsourced health claims ('sick season' defence, 'directly to your cells')
CTA label at 2.32:1 on orange; text down to 8px
53 endless loops with no pause; cookie banner covering half the phone screen
